lane_impact: L5 (UI/HUD) + items — a builder who initialises fresh items to uses=0 makes every item permanently Unbreakable. Fresh wearable items must start at uses=1 ('Well-Maintained'); uses=0 is reserved for the unbreakable class.
quote: public function gotUsed(num:int = 1) : * { if(this.uses == 0) { return; } ... this.uses += num; }  /  public function repair(num:int) : * { if(this.uses == 0) { return; } this.uses -= num; if(this.uses <= 0) { this.uses = 1; } }  /  if(this.uses == 0) { conditionStr = LangManager.getString(639); } else if(this.uses == 1) { conditionStr = LangManager.getString(392); }   [639='Unbreakable', 392='Condition: Well-Maintained']
text: uses == 0 is a sentinel meaning the item never degrades, not 'brand new': gotUsed() returns immediately when uses==0 and repair() clamps to a floor of 1, so 0 is unreachable once an item has ever worn — which is why the ladder's first branch is 'Unbreakable'.
